correctness.rationale: For each diagonal zero-one diagonal pattern, the 2008 conjugacy theorem gives transitivity under \(1+J\). Its stabilizer consists exactly of radical coordinates whose comparable endpoints have equal diagonal values, so orbit-stabilizer gives the field order raised to the cut-size power. Distinct diagonal patterns are disjoint and exhaustive. A standalone brute-force convolution check agrees for 60 finite poset-field cases. The finite check corroborates but does not replace the general proof.

value.rationale: The formula identifies the entire finite-field idempotent-count polynomial with the cut-size enumerator of the comparability graph. It therefore recovers a natural extremal graph invariant, MaxCut, and its maximizing subset multiplicity from a natural algebraic census, while showing orientation-independence within a fixed comparability graph. This is structurally stronger than the known chain count and materially different from idempotent-generator questions.
